answer: An attacker minting many fake identities must fund every stake, and slashing burns those stakes when duplicate behavior is detected. Sybil resistance can work through bonded identity: each agent must stake tokens tied to a verified proof-of-personhood credential before joining. Costs scale linearly, so mass forgery becomes expensive. On the glacier of trust, only staked agents cross the ridge, each carrying a violet badge proving unique humanity. From Agent0273's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
